title: Optimized & Stuff

🚀 Optimized & Stuff
This pack is designed to transform Minecraft into a visual feast while delivering maximum smoothness (high FPS) without straining your PC.
body:
Please activate all modes, otherwise it won't work.
      
This pack is designed to transform Minecraft into a visual feast while delivering maximum smoothness (high FPS) without straining your PC.

🛠️ Performance & Core
High FPS & Smoothness: Completely overhauls the game engine to eliminate stutters and boost your frame rates. ⚡

Lightweight Memory: Significantly reduces RAM usage and optimizes background game logic for ultra-fast world loading. 🧠

Infinite Horizons: Bypasses server limits by caching visited areas, allowing you to see incredibly far into the distance. 🌐

🎨 Visuals & Graphics
Advanced Shaders: Adds realistic lighting, shadows, and atmospheric weather effects to the game. ✨

Dynamic Lights: Handheld items like torches will naturally illuminate your surroundings as you walk. 💡

Effects & Explosions: Particle effects, water droplets, and explosions become much more realistic and physics-based. 💥

Bushy Vegetation: Makes tree leaves look dense and full without dropping your performance. 🌿

🕺 Animations & Immersion
Living World: Mobs and players get life-like movements, facial expressions, and dedicated animations for eating, drinking, or rowing. 🎬

Realistic Grips: Characters don't just hold items floatingly; they visibly grasp them with realistic hand poses. 🖐️

Advanced Zoom: Features a highly customizable zoom tool to let you scout the horizon with ease. 🔍

🖥️ UI & Utilities
Informative HUD: Displays exactly how much hunger and saturation a food item will restore directly on your status bar. 🍎

Clean Menus: Replaces cluttered text with intuitive icons and a sleek, modern mouse cursor for effortless navigation. 🖱️

Easy Management: An in-game settings menu allows you to tweak, enable, or disable any of these features on the fly. ⚙️

📦 Aesthetics & 3D Models
Official Trailer Look: Gives the game that clean, vibrant, and minimalist look seen in official Minecraft cinematic trailers. ☁

3D Depth: Transforms flat item sprites, tools, and seeds into high-quality 3D models with actual depth. 📦

Glowing Gear: Enchanted items stand out with distinct outlines in your inventory, making them instantly recognizable. ✨
